rules.title: Make responsibility practical through a role and a feasible contribution
rules.proposition: When he recognizes a group need and sees himself as leader or Crusader, Taylor can take a concrete burden: route choice, cover, coordination, an owned resource or an evacuation instruction. The role gives him a reason to act under fear, not superior knowledge or unlimited defensive capacity. His contribution can depend on a more skilled outsider and can be mistaken.
rules.support: MAIN02 C1 P443–458/P492–540 gives leadership, map use, a promised equal share and revised load sharing after Kazuma supplies information. P571–601/P659–686 gives particular defensive work and a chosen rear guard. DUST07 U012 P771–783 gives a real shield block with damage; U013 P488–494 gives an owned shield handover. DUST-CONT U014 P304–321 gives actual evacuation and P437–443 actual spear provision.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: He follows Keith rash charge after Leen suggests checking numbers (MAIN02 P548–573), helps force training and deliberately ignores Keith removal. A generic conscientious leader, class-role convention and ordinary cooperation are strong rival accounts. One good rear-guard decision is not a standing duty to protect everyone. An offered or transferred resource does not certify exact ownership of every later object or completed reimbursement.
rules.apply_when: The group need, his understood responsibility, time pressure and usable means are supplied. Separate the role he claims, authority others accept and what his body/equipment can actually do. An outsider demonstrated skill can change the feasible allocation.
rules.do_not_assume_when: There is no established responsibility, an unfamiliar task requires unshown expertise, or the action needs unlimited strength, healing, foresight or money. Do not give him Darkness endurance, Kazuma tactics, Keith vision, another person spell, a completed reward division or a successful defense not narrated.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: He can follow a poor initiative, misjudge a monster, offer cover that is physically overmatched, ask for help or call retreat when the situation changes. He can lend his shield rather than insist on being the sole front fighter. A role can increase willingness to accept danger without ensuring that he has understood it.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for specific burden taking and finite contributions, low for a universal duty hierarchy. Repeated comparable recognized group needs with available low-cost means but no attempt to help would weaken this tendency. Repeated refusal to adapt after an outsider clear useful contribution would weaken the allocation branch. Incapacity or a misunderstood need is not a clean preference test.

rules.title: Use procedure and recipient perspective while allowing admirable-motive bias
rules.proposition: When deliberation is possible, Taylor can ask for missing reports, point to a written fact and recast a plan from its recipient perspective. His disciplined manner does not prevent him from accepting an appealing account of honorable motives or repeating a relationship rumor. Evidence procedure and favorable moral interpretation are distinct operations; either may be absent in a particular scene.
rules.support: DUST-CONT U010 P53–56 corrects the wedding-country assumption from the invitation; P103–110 contrasts stated congratulations with an unverified accepted-confession claim. U012 P118–138 gives explicit wait-for-all procedure and still-open identity/contract alternatives; P170–184 gives the groom-perspective objection and agreement with Keith concern for Rionor. DUST07 U012 P390–395 and CONT U012 P28–38 give idealized defender/wager motives contested by Dust.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: He does not use Leen scouting warning before the MAIN02 attack and can join a concealed group plan without protecting the target informed choice. A generic organizer who sometimes idealizes friends explains much of this evidence. Dust cynicism is not an omniscient correction: mixed motives can include real care. No source establishes a universal truth-seeking disposition or exact confidence calculus.
rules.apply_when: There is time to gather a specified missing account, check a document or consider a known recipient. Preserve who observed, reported, inferred or privately knew each fact. Let a direct contradiction narrow a claim without requiring a complete moral or causal explanation.
rules.do_not_assume_when: Immediate danger makes waiting infeasible, the missing information is inaccessible, or the packet does not supply the alleged relationship. Do not make no bad rumor a complete absence certificate, imagined extortion an actual crime, a favorable public reputation a private truth, or gossip a ratified romance. Do not give him the reader hidden final contract.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: He may overread a flattering or honorable explanation, apologize for an imagined slight, or accept a shared assumption while competently organizing the meeting. An explicit contrary statement can revise that local inference. Under immediate danger, responsibility can select evacuation before full explanation instead of rigidly waiting for every report.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for the observed procedural and perspective operations, low for their frequency or dominance. Matched feasible deliberations where he repeatedly dismisses known missing reports without considering them would weaken the information component. Consistently accurate motive appraisal where favorable and instrumental explanations conflict would narrow the idealization branch. A source-known hypothetical cannot estimate either frequency.

rules.title: Let loyalty and coalition shape intervention, with a repair that may remain partial
rules.proposition: Taylor can endorse an in-group plan as useful or deserved and help impose it despite a companion refusal. He can also withdraw from a socially uncomfortable conflict instead of protecting its target. Later guilt, responsibility or renewed company can produce apology and material help without complete restitution or a permanent change of conduct. Respect for one person affiliation does not become a universal refusal rule.
rules.support: MAIN02 C1 P636 stops recruitment because Kazuma has a return place. DUST07 U011 P748–785 gives Taylor hard-training idea, approval of the hidden destination and direct shoulder restraint after Dust tries to leave. P901–947 gives his initiated apology, money bag and continuing recipient fear. U012 P299–305 gives his chosen nonhelp during Keith removal. U013 P488–494 gives restraint of Keith and an owned shield handover; U014 P105–108/P133 gives a personal apology and praise.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: Choosing a rear guard, correcting recipient-risk blindness and evacuation show actual care beyond conformity. Generic in-group bias, perceived military necessity, conflict avoidance and local comic convention remain rivals; there is no direct private weighting for each act. Group binding and an offstage attack cannot all be assigned to his individual hand. A cash bag is not proof that he personally paid the full amount or that the recipient recovered.
rules.apply_when: The packet supplies a familiar group, a desired collective aim, a person refusal or a specific repair opportunity. Keep his role in the current decision explicit. A known objection remains an objection even when he ignores it. An apology can be sincere while incomplete.
rules.do_not_assume_when: No group position, grievance, means of intervention or knowledge of the refusal is supplied. Do not invent universal malice, a legal verdict, exact personal payment, forced forgiveness, completed aftercare or a hidden ethical veto that the source does not support.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: He can grip an objector shoulder while invoking earlier broad assent, stand aside from retaliation, or use a joke to avoid a conflict. He can later own some fault, offer an available resource or apologize for an interruption. Immediate danger, changed information or a newly salient recipient can instead prompt intervention. These branches must not be made equally certain or selected solely to explain every outcome afterward.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: High for recorded care/coercion coexistence, low-to-moderate for a novel coalition threshold. Repeated matched group plans in which he stops an appealing imposition at an explicit informed refusal would weaken the override component. Comprehensive recipient-led repair that consistently tracks remaining costs would challenge the partial-repair expectation. Later benefit, forgiveness or continued friendship cannot falsify the original adverse process.
